image_description: A group of Australian Pelicans standing on a sandy shore next to blue water. The birds display characteristic white plumage with black flight feathers, long pinkish bills with gular pouches, and webbed feet. One pelican in the center stands tall, while others are seated or partially cropped at the edges.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the interface between the white feathers and the blue water background, as well as the contact points where feet meet the sand. AI models often struggle with high-contrast edges on white birds, creating 'halo' effects or melting the feathers into the water. Additionally, verify the toe webbing on the visible feet; AI frequently generates partial webbing or fuses toes together incorrectly. Ensure that overlapping birds in the group remain distinct entities without morphological fusion.
